question: For a given library, where does it land across imports, declared dependencies, and paper-text mentions?
methodology: Each view first has same-view alternate spellings collapsed via the curated software-name-alternates table (e.g. a pypi dependency named "torch" and a conda dependency named "pytorch"), then ranked to top-200-by-distinct-count in each of the three views (imports, dependencies pooled across ecosystems, mentions), restricted to high-precision article-repository links. The three top-N lists are then reconciled into canonical cross-view library identities via rs_graph.utils.software_alignment.align_software_names() (Hungarian assignment + rapidfuzz, cutoff=90.0) pairwise across all three views, unioned greedily highest-score-first with a same-view collision guard (see module docstring for why that guard matters). A null count/rank means the library fell outside that view's top 200 -- not that it was measured and found at zero.
